description: Source code for a library related to UPnP (Universal Plug and Play) functions, including serial number retrieval, IP address fetching, and account ID management, with platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: getserialnum
methods.description: Retrieves the device serial number from different platform-specific sources.

methods.name: getipaddress
methods.description: Fetches the IP address for a given network interface, supporting IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: check_null
methods.description: Checks if a string pointer is non-null.

methods.name: check_empty
methods.description: Checks if a string is non-empty.

methods.name: getAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the account ID from platform-specific configuration or RFC parameters.
